name: core.openwop.connections.shippo
description: Shippo connection pack (RFC 0095) — api_key provider for the commerce shipping-rate seam (ADR 0250). Category is `other` (openai-images precedent): the normative `category` enum has no `shipping` value and the seam resolves by `id` (`shippo`), not category — no wire/RFC change. When configured AND the org sets `commerce.shipFrom` AND the cart's physical lines all carry a weight, `features/commerce/taxShipping.ts` calls Shippo's rate API (POST https://api.goshippo.com/v1/shipments) at checkout and bills the CHEAPEST rate; ANY missing input/error/timeout falls back to the flat/manual rate — a carrier hiccup never blocks a sale. Rate quotes are READ calls (not money movement) — no commerce-spend gate. Credentials stay host-side via the Connections broker; the request carries only the from/to postal + parcel weight, never customer contact details. Carries NO secret (ADR 0024 §7).
